definitions.gloss: street fighting; urban warfare; fighting in a city
definitions.explanation: Combat that takes place in the streets and buildings of a town or city, as opposed to fighting in open country.

examples.japanese: ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{市街戦|しがいせん}。
⟦{首都|しゅと}→首都：03224_shuto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{市街戦|しがいせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Street fighting continues in the capital.

examples.japanese: {市街戦|しがいせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{民間人|みんかんじん}→民間人：31709_minkanjin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれ→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{破壊|はかい}→破壊：13678_hakai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Civilians were caught up in the street fighting, and many buildings were destroyed.

notes:
⟦{市街|しがい}→市街：12468_shigai⟧ (city streets) + ⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧ (battle). A news and history term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {市街戦|しがいせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to turn into street fighting
- {市街戦|しがいせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}こる→起こる：01910_okoru⟧: street fighting breaks out
- ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{市街戦|しがいせん}: fierce urban combat

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{紫外線|しがいせん}→紫外線：07375_shigaisen⟧: same reading, but means ultraviolet rays; context always makes clear which is meant
